title: Acceptance list (fact:acceptance and acceptance.json)
description: Spec 8.3 acceptance.json: "The items: id, text, form, surfaces, citations, trust, status: failing, evidence: [], parent: null". One schema for the fact ({ items }) and the packet file, which adds the optional envelope schemaVersion and parent.

schemaVersion.description: Packet-file envelope: present in the file written to the scope packet (aw-packets: every JSON file carries schemaVersion 1), absent in the fact.

parent.description: Packet-file envelope: the scope packet hash this file extends, or null.

id.description: An acceptance item id (spec 7.3: blocks ["AC-4"]). The answer-log id is A<n>.

form.description: SCP-ACC-001: form: ears, or form: plain with a reason.

reason.description: Required with form plain: what is missing.

items.description: A surface id in the scope map.

citations.description: Ids that resolve (SCP-CITE-001): a lens item L-<lens>-<n>, a source ref R<n> in fact:brief.refs, or an answer A<n> in the answer log.

option.description: Spec 7.4: the option id an answer chose (Q3.a).

trust.description: Stamped by code (SCP-TRUST-001). The spec 7.3 example carries it on a question; a draft-stage model-written value is a finding, so it is optional here.
